thesis: Shape the show as a controlled disappearance arc: tense center-held darkness gradually dissolves into wider cool beams so the feeling of fading away reads as intentional release, not collapse.

artist_branding.summary: Massano and braev align with dark melodic club language: cinematic pressure, precise build pacing, and emotionally restrained peaks that favor atmosphere over constant maximal output.
visual_cues: Cold-toned tension beds with measured intensity ramps
Long phrase transitions that preserve narrative momentum
Selective white accents reserved for structural payoff
do_not_copy: Do not clone exact touring stage architecture, branded visuals, or recognizable cue-for-cue set pieces from official performances.

motifs: Geometry motif: center locks that blur outward into wider ring coverage
Color motif: graphite-blue and violet body with sparse silver-white release moments
Movement motif: slow decays and delayed returns, then tighter bar-grid accents in peaks

visual_direction.color_story: Keep the base in dark blue-violet tones and let neutral white appear only when the phrase fully resolves.
visual_direction.motion_story: Favor glide-first transitions in intros and breakdowns, then tighten movement cadence in drop-family bars.
visual_direction.staging_story: Use PARs as the atmospheric glue while movers narrate the fade trajectory through repeated center-to-edge expansion.

must_include: At least one extended low-density phase before the first major release
Phrase-level contrast between suspended breakdown bars and drop bars
A late-track widening moment that clearly sells the fade-away concept
avoid: Early full-bright treatment that removes narrative headroom
Constant high-rate strobe across melodic passages
Unrelated palette jumps that break the dissolve metaphor
